name: image-cropper
title: Image Cropper
description: A picture with a frame over it that chooses the part to keep: dragged or resized by its corners, or moved with the arrow keys and resized with plus and minus, optionally held to a shape (square, 16:9); the choice comes out as fractions and as pixels of the original.

meta.when: Cropping an avatar, a cover picture, a product photo before upload. The cutting itself is the project's (a canvas, the server); this gives the rectangle. For marking areas on a picture use image-annotator; for comparing two pictures use compare-slider.
meta.example: <ImageCropper src="/photo.jpg" alt="The harbour at dawn" aspect={1} onCropChange={(crop) => setCrop(crop.pixels)} />
